name: Needed
description: Needed makes perinatal and prenatal nutrition products, with HQ in West Los Angeles per its official FAQ. Its Needed Academy is a free education program for affiliate, ambassador and practitioner partners, and its Partner Hub pays partners commission via ShopMy, Impact and TikTok Shop plus a paid UGC program.

evidence.summary: Official Needed Partner Hub fetched: 'ShopMy — 16% commission on every sale. Impact — Up to $75 per new customer you influence. TikTok Shop — Up to 20% commission on every sale.' Also: 'Top partners are making thousands monthly.' That earnings line is NOT an explicit no-cap/unlimited statement, and no other cap wording appears — commission_cap is unknown. Ambassador contact on the page: ambassadors@thisisneeded.com. Rate field = 20, the highest published % (TikTok Shop).

Partner Hub: 'Join our UGC Program and create content for Needed to launch in paid ads. We'll pay you $100 for every selected piece.' Perks also include regular gifting to creators, increased-commission opportunities, content boosting, and top-partner paid campaigns, whitelisting, event invites and features.

Official Needed Academy page: completing the free program and a short quiz lets you 'partner with us, which unlocks perks including commission, free products, discounts to share with your community, exclusive sneak peeks.' It also states partners 'join our community of thousands of partners for life' — evidence of a large existing partner base, recorded as high creator saturation.

Official FAQ: 'you can email us at hello@thisisneeded.com or message us through Instagram at @needed'; 'Needed HQ is located in sunny West Los Angeles'; for the Practitioner Referral Program rewards, 'email us at practitioners@thisisneeded.com'.

opportunity.title: Needed UGC Program — $100 for every selected piece (via Partner Hub)

reasons.niche_fit: Perinatal nutrition is a strong, specific health niche
reasons.ugc_evidence: Explicit paid UGC program ($100 per selected piece) plus gifting and content boosting on official Partner Hub
reasons.compensation: Multiple published rates (16% ShopMy, up to $75 Impact, up to 20% TikTok Shop) but no explicit uncapped statement
reasons.contact_access: Published ambassadors email plus Partner Hub and Academy application routes
reasons.opportunity_availability: Partner Hub, Academy/Champion route and UGC program all open
reasons.credibility: Practitioner-developed positioning, HQ and full FAQ on official domain
